# ── Hunk 2: WebView UI resources — ONE binary-data target (two collide on the
#    BinaryData namespace: memory critical_dual_binary_data_namespace_collision).
#    The v2 UI is a SINGLE index.html (the 3D view — WebGL2 + Canvas 2D fallback —
#    lives inline; no js/geometry-view.js, no css/wavetable-editor.css, no
#    js/wavetable-editor.js). The only new resource is the botanical plate.
 juce_add_binary_data(O-Strata_UIResources
     SOURCES
         Source/ui/public/index.html
         Source/ui/public/js/i18n.js
         Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js
         Source/ui/public/js/juce/check_native_interop.js
+        Source/ui/public/img/shell_conchologiaiconi12reev_0090.png   # BinaryData::shell_conchologiaiconi12reev_0090_png (no hyphen → nothing stripped)
 )
#  Every file here must ALSO be routed in PluginEditor::getResource() with the
#  right MIME type (image/png for the plate; application/javascript for .js) —
#  embedded-but-not-served presents as a missing panel (check-i18n assertion 8).
